experiment_data.hypothesis: Flat-NLI reward with kl_coef=0.01 + num_generations=8 from SFT scratch (not resume). 100-step probe to verify stability. Same D020 config as ced_kl001_r4 (which is healthy). Tests whether flat-NLI reward type works under stable training config.

spec.command: bash -c "source /etc/network_turbo && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -m freige.training.grpo_trainer --model_name /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-4B --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output --data_dir /root/autodl-tmp/data/docred --stage 2 --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/grpo_flatnli_r6 --num_generations 8 --reward_device cuda --per_device_batch_size 1 --gradient_accumulation_steps 16 --num_epochs 1 --learning_rate 5e-5 --seed 42 --kl_coef 0.01 --save_steps 10 --save_total_limit 20 --max_steps 100 --format_reward_weight 0.3 --f1_reward_weight 3.0 --ced_reward_weight 1.0 --num_iterations 1 --wandb_run_name grpo-s2-flatnli-r6"

experiment_data.notes:
D020 配置：kl_coef=0.01 + num_generations=8 + save_steps=10 + max_steps=100。从 SFT 全新训练（不 resume），修复 r5 的恢复问题。加 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 解决 stdout 缓冲问题，加 --wandb_run_name grpo-s2-flatnli-r6 方便实时监控。✅ F1 门控已在代码中生效（--ced_reward_weight 1.0 在 stage 2 控制 flat-NLI reward 权重）。
